description_en: Imports a local image to Cloud Phone as a custom image in the specified region
description_zh: 导入一份您的本地镜像到云手机，作为自定义镜像出现在相应地域中
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone import-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --oss-bucket myOssBucket --oss-object myOssKeyForImage.raw --region cn-hangzhou
name: ImportImage

parameters.help_en: The region to which the image is imported
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The OSS bucket where the image file is stored
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The key of the OSS object where the image file is stored
parameters.help_zh: 镜像文件所在的OSS Object的文件名称（key）
parameters.name: oss_object

parameters.help_en: The image name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）
parameters.name: image_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The operating system distribution. Valid values:
Android 9.0
parameters.help_zh:
操作系统发行版。取值范围：
Android 9.0
parameters.name: platform

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the imported Cloud Phone image
